details:
Currently the 'read more' text in the profile menu for the bio is the only button that allows you to read the full bio in the new UI, 

Said button is needlessly small and difficult to press on VR, which is the assumedly intended experience, 

It seems unlikely that the new UI will be substantially changed before being pushed to the main branch, however I can see two ways in which this navigational challenge can be tackled, 

Either with the 'read more' being removed entirely and it being fully shown by default, or with the entire bio section being considered a button instead of just the small text, 

As a VR first game, if that is still the intent of the platform, the UI should not blindly follow the desktop website that seems to inspire the new UI, they are different mediums with different control schemes and the methods of control should reflect the platform to provide the best user experience 

As a little bonus aside, the new UI's nameplates have a lot of dead space by default, the profile picture is giant and makes the name take up only a third of the nameplate's background, so a lot of dead air that takes up space, 

This seems inspired by Discord, however, as a interactive 3d space with virtual avatars, the profile picture does not necessitate as much attention as it does with the inspiration, 

Not sure how to go about changing this but it does make it a little harder to read names as compared to the old UI in my experience
title: VR Minded Navigation For Menu/Bio (New UI)
